title: Shiori shared definitions (contract v1)
description: Shared definitions referenced by the other v1 schemas. $id values use the reserved .invalid domain: they are identifiers, never fetch locations.

status.description: Lifecycle status shared by plans, phases and steps. Order is significant: draft is the default and the update placeholder value.

severity.description: Review finding severity, most to least severe.

findingStatus.description: Finding lifecycle. Absent in legacy documents; absent is NOT resolved.

nonblank.description: String that is non-empty after trimming the ECMAScript whitespace set (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF). Validators must trim with exactly that set, not a locale or ASCII-only set.

workplanId.description: Caller-supplied workplan id. Must contain at least one ASCII letter or digit (case-insensitive) and be nonblank after trimming. Stored ids are the normalized form (see x-shiori-normalization).
workplanId.x-shiori-normalization: trim; lowercase; replace each maximal run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with a single '-'; strip leading/trailing '-'; truncate to 80 UTF-16 code units; empty result is an error 'Workplan id must contain at least one letter or number'.

isoDatetimeUtc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp as accepted by the reference validator: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with optional :SS and optional fractional seconds, mandatory trailing Z, no offsets. Calendar validity (month lengths, leap years) is checked semantically.

manifestEntry.description: One artifact in a snapshot manifest. Exactly one of sha256 or missing=true. Canonical key order for hashing is path, then sha256 or missing.

stepRef.description: Composite step identity. Step ids are unique only within a phase.
